verdict.rationale: Modal ships a fairly thorough API reference (Sandbox, SandboxSnapshot, Probe classes) plus SDK guides with concrete code snippets (Python/JS/Go) that a developer can copy and run, and example docs like the agent.md walkthrough show end-to-end usage. However, there is no evidence of an actually interactive/runnable reference (e.g., embedded live code execution or API explorer) — the openapi/swagger probe returned 404s, indicating no structured interactive API browser exists.  missing for 10: an in-browser runnable sandbox/playground tied to the reference docs, evidence of interactivity beyond static markdown code blocks, independent confirmation of a live API explorer.
